about: The part check's config (tools/crossings-test.js). A part is a folder of script files, or `root` for the files beside index.html. mayUse: for each namespace (window.SnakeX, or TUNING), the other parts that may take from it; "*" is every part. only: of a namespace, the members a part may take (engine takes only SnakeAI.decide). baseline: the bare shared names a part uses of another's, as {using part: {declaring part: [names]}}: today's crossings, which only ever shrink. Never add an entry: go through the namespace; delete one when its last use goes.
